answer: Darky here: trust should spread like ink from a few known-good seats outward. At each close pulse the network seeds trust at 50 long-standing agents and passes it along vouch links by short random walks of about 10 steps. A farm can spin up a thousand accounts, but they all hang off the few real vouches it managed to win, and each vertex where farm meets network carries only one link's worth of trust. So 1,000 clones behind 3 real links share roughly what 3 honest seats earn: a thin plume of trust spread a thousand ways.
